intro: IM-1 was Intuitive Machines' first Moon mission and the first American landing on the Moon since Apollo 17. Its Nova-C lander Odysseus launched on 15 February 2024 and touched down on 22 February near Malapert A, about 300 km from the south pole. It came in at about 7.8 m/s with sideways motion, broke a leg and tipped over, but kept working for about seven days.
